principles: Keep verificationIntent as the explicit acceptance contract.
Make legacy repair auditable instead of implicit.
Reuse existing signed workspace resolution for gitRoot behavior.
Prefer narrow CLI defects and focused smokes over broad framework churn.
drivers: The ClawCreek incident blocks real workflow closure even after evidence exists.
High-risk lifecycle gates must remain fail-closed for normal future stories.
Wrapper-root projects with configured gitRoot must be able to use automatic INIT_CHECK bootstrap.

options.name: A: Add explicit repair command plus gitRoot bootstrap root fix
pros: Preserves current review discipline while unblocking historical stories.
Gives users a repeatable command instead of manual metadata edits.
Fixes the bootstrap failure at the root-resolution layer already used by session_brief.
cons: Requires command registration and smoke coverage across lifecycle gates.
Generated intent text must be carefully worded so it does not pretend to be pre-authored.

options.name: B: Let existing evidence satisfy missing intent automatically
pros: Smallest immediate change for B-5a12-style stories.
Avoids adding a new operator command.
cons: Weakens verificationIntent as the acceptance contract.
Makes future stories easier to pass without PLAN discipline.
Hides schema migration behind review behavior instead of recording an audit event.

options.name: C: Keep code unchanged and document a manual checklist_update workaround
pros: Avoids touching command registry or bootstrap code.
cons: Leaves users with a fragile manual recovery path.
Does not solve automatic worktree bootstrap for configured gitRoot projects.
Does not give story_review or validate an actionable diagnosis.

chosen: A: Add explicit repair command plus gitRoot bootstrap root fix
rationale: Option A is the only choice that fixes both observed Lattice defects while preserving the lifecycle contract. It gives legacy stories a controlled migration path and keeps normal future stories strict.

preMortem.scenario: Repair command overwrites authored verification intent.
preMortem.trigger: Implementation treats evidence refs as authoritative for all lanes without checking existing intent.
preMortem.consequence: Reviewer-authored acceptance criteria are lost and future review behavior becomes untrustworthy.
preMortem.mitigation: Default to fill-only behavior, require replaceExisting plus strong reason for replacement, and add non-overwrite smoke coverage.

preMortem.scenario: story_review stops blocking missing intent when evidence exists.
preMortem.trigger: Diagnostic upgrade is implemented as a pass condition instead of a hint.
preMortem.consequence: Normal stories can skip PLAN intent and still pass review, undoing the second-generation flow discipline.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep blocker severity; only add evidence-aware issue fields and repair command hints.

preMortem.scenario: gitRoot bootstrap still runs git commands from metadata root.
preMortem.trigger: worktree.ts keeps using getRepoRoot from cwd instead of signed workspace resolution.
preMortem.consequence: Wrapper-root projects continue to need manual worktree creation and INIT_CHECK loses its preflight value.
preMortem.mitigation: Route bootstrap through the signed workspace material root and add nested gitRoot INIT_CHECK smoke coverage.

preMortem.scenario: The story expands into the already-verified help import issue.
preMortem.trigger: A developer touches sourceManifestDigest without reproducing the failure.
preMortem.consequence: Scope expands into unrelated runtime export churn and makes review harder.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep P3 excluded; only allow a read-only help-command smoke unless the failure reproduces as a separate story.
